description: This file is a shell script used for configuring and managing LAN interfaces, including Ethernet and wireless interfaces, on a network device. It contains functions for bringing interfaces up/down, managing DHCP, configuring VLANs, bridging, routing, and handling system events related to LAN setup.

methods.name: subnet
methods.description: Calculates and outputs the subnet address based on provided IP and subnet mask parameters.

methods.name: isvalid
methods.description: Checks if a given IP address segment is valid for subnet calculations.

methods.name: calbits
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1 in a given integer, used for subnet mask calculations.

methods.name: mask2cidr
methods.description: Converts a dotted-decimal subnet mask to CIDR prefix length.

methods.name: enslave_a_interface
methods.description: Enslaves a physical or virtual interface to a bridge.

methods.name: bringup_ethernet_interfaces
methods.description: Configures and brings up Ethernet interfaces, including VLAN setup if virtual interfaces are used.

methods.name: teardown_ethernet_interfaces
methods.description: Brings down Ethernet interfaces and unconfigures VLANs if applicable.

methods.name: bringup_wireless_interfaces
methods.description: Configures and brings up wireless interfaces and their virtual interfaces.

methods.name: teardown_wireless_interfaces
methods.description: Brings down wireless interfaces and their virtual interfaces.

methods.name: restart_necessary_functions
methods.description: Placeholder for functions that need to be restarted after interface changes.

methods.name: do_start
methods.description: Starts LAN services by bringing up interfaces, setting IP addresses, and configuring routing and bridging.

methods.name: do_stop
methods.description: Stops LAN services, bringing down interfaces and removing routing configurations.

methods.name: do_start_no_bridge
methods.description: Brings up LAN interface without configuring bridge, used when bridge setup is not desired.

methods.name: do_stop_no_bridge
methods.description: Stops LAN interface without bridge, used when bridge is not configured.

methods.name: do_start_lan_dhcp
methods.description: Starts DHCP client on LAN interface.

methods.name: do_stop_lan_dhcp
methods.description: Stops DHCP client on LAN interface.

methods.name: register_lan_dhcp_handler
methods.description: Registers DHCP event handlers.

methods.name: unregister_lan_dhcp_handler
methods.description: Unregisters DHCP event handlers.

methods.name: lan_create
methods.description: Creates and configures LAN bridge and enslaves interfaces.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes LAN configuration by gathering system info and creating necessary interfaces and bridges.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts LAN service, bringing interfaces up and configuring routing.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops LAN service, tearing down interfaces and routes.

methods.name: add_docsis_bridge
methods.description: Adds LAN interfaces to a bridge for DOCSIS setup.

methods.name: register_docsis_handler
methods.description: Registers a handler for DOCSIS initialization events.
